name: Demet karşılama işareti
purpose: 64px sarı kutu içindeki roketin yerine; şeffaf, sadeleştirilmiş maymun başı ve elde çiçek demeti.
prompt:
Create ONE custom small-interface brand pictogram for the Demet Windows app, derived from the attached approved capuchin-monkey-with-flower-bouquet logo. The reference is for CHARACTER IDENTITY AND CONCEPT only. This new asset will replace a 28px rocket glyph centered within an existing 64px amber rounded square. It must work at 44–48px display size.
DELIVERABLE: isolated single dark-ink pictogram on a truly TRANSPARENT background, high-resolution square PNG, 1024x1024 or larger. Do not include the amber square, any colored background, a badge, a frame, a circle container or a mockup.
DESIGN: Reduce the logo to the essential monkey head, a small suggestion of shoulder, and ONE monkey hand gripping a small bouquet. A natural capuchin head in gentle three-quarter profile faces right, placed left of center, with one rounded ear, recognizable monkey brow/cap, small realistic eye, short muzzle. Under and to the right of its face, a short curved arm leads to a tiny clean hand actually clasping the gathered stems of THREE simple flowers. Flower heads form a compact fan at the upper-right: two simple five-petal blossoms with single dark centers and one simple tulip bud. One leaf at most. The hand, stems, flowers and monkey form ONE coherent connected silhouette. Head and bouquet dominate; no full seated body, legs, feet or curled tail. No ribbon bow needed at this size.
VISUAL STYLE: A sophisticated minimal custom ink mark with clear negative spaces, confident gently varied contour strokes and only 2–3 subtle short hair accents to retain the character of the engraved brand. Simplify deliberately for readability, not a miniaturized detailed engraving. Line weight equivalent to approximately 1.8–2.2px at 48px display; no hairline strokes, no crosshatching or fur texture. Natural adult monkey identity, warm but not cartoonish, not a human face, no oversized baby eyes, no exaggerated smile. Clean rounded stroke ends, large open shapes. Overall composition fills about 88% of the square, optically balanced and comfortably separated from the edge.
PALETTE: ONLY charcoal-dark ink #17150F. All internal face, petal and body negative areas are transparent rather than filled white or ivory. No white background or white fill, no gray shading, no amber fill, no colored flowers, no green leaves. The actual existing amber UI tile must show through every open area.
No typography, no lettering, no rocket, no decoration, no glow, no shadow, no gradients, no 3D, no photographic detail. Output exactly ONE transparent pictogram.
